_comment: The groups this system runs. Each has its own Google Sheet, its own
Telegram group, and its own prices. Nothing is shared between them except
the payments bot and the posting bot.
Secrets are NOT here. For a group with envPrefix APPSC_NEWS_EN, .env must
carry SHEET_URL_APPSC_NEWS_EN, SHEET_TOKEN_APPSC_NEWS_EN and
TELEGRAM_GROUP_APPSC_NEWS_EN. Keeping the shape here and the secrets there
means this file can be read, reviewed and committed safely.
planShapes below defines what a pass IS. Each group then sets what it
COSTS, so a price can differ per group without five copies of the wording.
paymentBotEnv says which payment bot sells this group. Groups sharing a value
share a bot, so a student buying either newspaper group talks to one bot.
subjects is the tab list for that group's sheet. The Apps Script reads it from
a SUBJECTS_JSON script property, so the same google_apps_script.js is pasted
into every sheet and each one declares its own subjects rather than five
copies of the file drifting apart.
⚠️ TEST-STAGE PRICING: every group is currently on Rs 1 / Rs 2 / Rs 3 so the
payment flow can be exercised end to end with real money at negligible cost.
Put the real prices back before students are given the bot. Note that the
recurring plan's amount is baked into the Razorpay plan, so changing
autopay_monthly here is not enough: remove RAZORPAY_PLAN_<PREFIX> from .env
and re-run `node setup-razorpay.js` to mint a plan at the new price. A
subscription is refused outright when the two disagree, so a student can
never be charged an amount other than the one they were shown.

shortName is what the dashboard switcher shows. The full label and language are too long for the header, and a truncated group name is worse than a short one: it is the field that says which sheet you are about to write to.

ONE PASS: only exam_pass is sold, at Rs 199 (19900 paise). sprint_30 and autopay_monthly are "retired": no longer offered anywhere, but still defined so a member who bought one keeps working — their renewal webhook, reminders and /cancel all still look the plan up by id. Do not delete them while anyone holds one. The pass name, price and valid-until date can be overridden per bot from the dashboard (Pass & Coupons page) without editing this file.

sprint_30.label: 30-Day Sprint Pass
sprint_30.description: Full access to every subject topic for 30 days.

autopay_monthly.label: Monthly Auto-Pay
autopay_monthly.description: Renews itself every 30 days over UPI AutoPay or card. Cancel whenever you like.

exam_pass.label: Target 2026 Pass
exam_pass.tagline: Valid until exam day — best value
exam_pass.description: One payment, access right through to the exam. No renewals to remember.
